body.condition: For distinct \(i,j\in V\) and all \(a,b\in M\), \(\operatorname{Cov}_P(\varepsilon_i^{(a)},\varepsilon_j^{(b)})=0\).

novel.justification: This condition is imposed only in the component-aligned refinement. It is not part of the published unrestricted-cross-view class; there, off-diagonal cross-view residual covariances are nuisance. The refinement is satisfied by coordinate-aligned repeated sensors with independent coordinate shocks and positive-variance readout errors.
